scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,admin -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @satsolutions/api" "npm run dev -w @satsolutions/web" "npm run dev -w @satsolutions/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @satsolutions/api && npm run build -w @satsolutions/web && npm run build -w @satsolutions/admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @satsolutions/web && npm run lint -w @satsolutions/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @satsolutions/api && npm run typecheck -w @satsolutions/web && npm run typecheck -w @satsolutions/admin
